scenario.name: ramp-cpu-ort-b4
scenario.description: Task 5.5, one variable changed from ramp-cpu-ort: up to 4 claimed frames (any cameras) per forward pass (infer_batch 4; E-046: +16% model-only for ONNX Runtime at batch 4). The worker takes what is claimed and never waits to fill a batch. Containerized ingest + one yolo11n worker + Postgres + object store, data-mini at 5 FPS per camera (1280x720 q85), steps of 1 to 5 cameras (5 added over ramp-cpu in case 4 passes), warmup 20 s, hold 90 s, 3 repetitions, no query load. Start the worker with WORKER_BACKEND=onnxruntime WORKER_INFER_BATCH=4; expect_worker refuses any other configuration. Quiet host: nothing else CPU-heavy.
